channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: PKK leader declares 'end of violence-based' era in fresh message
item.description: Jailed PKK leader Abdullah Öcalan issued a new statement on Feb. 27, on the first anniversary of his call for the terror group to disband and end armed activities, declaring an end to “violence-based” politics.

item.title: Memory of Island: Kadeau
item.description: Modern Nordic cuisine at Kadeau is not a passing trend but a disciplined continuation of Bornholm’s preservation culture, where geography shapes technique and memory defines taste.

item.title: ‘Turquality’ initiative targets branded Turkish foods in US
item.description: A new strategic push under the government-supported “Turquality” program aims to place Turkish food products on American retail shelves as branded, value-added offerings, sector representatives have said.

item.title: Turkish navy ships draw crowds in Rotterdam
item.description: Türkiye’s amphibious assault ship TCG Anadolu and three accompanying naval vessels drew crowds and heavy local media interest after docking in the Port of Rotterdam as part of NATO’s Steadfast Dart 2026 exercise.

item.title: Intelligence academy report flags three flashpoints that could trigger wider war
item.description: Türkiye’s National Intelligence Academy (MİA), an education and research body operating under the National Intelligence Organization (MİT), has published a new report warning that three potential flashpoints could evolve into conflicts on a much wider scale.

item.title: Oil markets brace for volatility after US, Israel launch strikes on Iran
item.description: The U.S. strikes against Iran could severely disrupt the global supply of crude oil and send prices soaring to levels not seen in years.

item.title: Airspace closed, flights cancelled as US, Israel strike Iran
item.description: Flights across the Middle East were being cancelled Saturday as several countries slammed their airspace shut after the United States and Israel launched strikes on Iran.

item.title: Fidan holds calls with seven counterparts as tensions escalate in region
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan held phone calls on Feb. 28 with the foreign ministers of Iran, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Syria, Egypt and Indonesia to discuss the rapidly escalating regional situation and possible steps to help end the attacks, Turkish diplomatic sources said.

item.title: US, Israel launch strikes on Iran, Tehran hits back across region
item.description: The United States and Israel launched strikes against Iran on Saturday, with Israel's public broadcaster reporting that supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei had been targeted, as the Islamic republic retaliated with barrages of missiles at Gulf states and Israel.

item.title: Türkiye urges end to attacks, offers mediation as Iran crisis escalates
item.description: Türkiye said it is ready to support mediation efforts as violence surged after U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran and Tehran’s retaliation, warning the unfolding crisis carries “serious risks” for both regional and global stability.
